Este profissional atuará desde a descoberta e pré-venda até o desenho, a implementação e a evolução das soluções, produzindo diagramas de arquitetura, decisões arquiteturais, estimativas técnicas, provas de conceito e direcionamentos para os times de desenvolvimento.      Também será responsável por exercer a liderança técnica da equipe, estabelecer padrões de engenharia, facilitar decisões, apoiar a resolução de problemas complexos e desenvolver tecnicamente profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade. A posição exige excelente comunicação com públicos técnicos, executivos, comerciais e clientes      Arquitetura e decisões técnicas    Conduzir discovery técnico, identificando requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, restrições, riscos, integrações, requisitos regulatórios e critérios de sucesso.   • Definir arquiteturas de alto e baixo nível, incluindo diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, rede, segurança, dados e implantação.   • Documentar decisões por meio de Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), registrando contexto, alternativas, trade-offs, impactos e consequências.   • Definir requisitos de disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, observabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup e recuperação de desastres.   • Conduzir revisões com base nos seis pilares do AWS Well-Architected Framework: excelência operacional, segurança, confiabilidade, eficiência de performance, otimização de custos e sustentabilidade.   • Avaliar alternativas técnicas e selecionar serviços AWS considerando adequação ao problema, segurança, custo total, esforço operacional e riscos de dependência.   • Criar e manter padrões, arquiteturas de referência, guias e componentes reutilizáveis.      Pré-vendas e relacionamento com clientes   • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial durante discovery, qualificação e desenho de oportunidades.   • Participar de reuniões, workshops e apresentações técnicas com clientes, adaptando a comunicação ao público técnico ou executivo.   • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em propostas técnicas, arquiteturas, escopo, premissas e planos de implementação.   • Elaborar estimativas de esforço, capacidade, custos AWS e Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).   • Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs, questionários técnicos, requisitos de segurança e processos de due diligence.   • Criar e apresentar demonstrações e provas de conceito, tratando objeções e explicando alternativas, riscos e trade-offs.   • Realizar handoff estruturado entre vendas e delivery, assegurando alinhamento entre a solução proposta e a implementação.      Liderança técnica e desenvolvimento da equipe   • Atuar como Tech Lead e principal referência técnica da equipe, sem necessariamente exercer gestão administrativa de pessoas.   • Facilitar decisões e criar alinhamento entre engenharia, projetos, produto, segurança, operações e vendas.   • Estabelecer padrões de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes, segurança, observabilidade, documentação e revisão de código.   • Orientar o roadmap técnico, a evolução das plataformas e a priorização de débito técnico e riscos de engenharia.   • Conduzir design reviews, code reviews e revisões de prontidão para produção com critérios objetivos de qualidade.   • Realizar mentoria, pairing e feedback técnico, apoiando planos de desenvolvimento de profissionais júnior, pleno e sênior.   • Promover treinamentos internos, comunidades de prática e compartilhamento de conhecimento, reduzindo dependências individuais.   • Apoiar recrutamento, entrevistas e avaliação técnica de candidatos.   • Influenciar decisões técnicas com clareza, respeito e dados, mesmo sem autoridade hierárquica direta.      Implementação, operação e melhoria contínua   • Liderar o desenho e a implementação de soluções utilizando Terraform e práticas avançadas de Infrastructure as Code.   • Desenvolver provas de conceito e componentes críticos utilizando Python, Node.js, Type Script, Go ou outra linguagem adotada pela equipe.   • Definir e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, controles Dev Sec Ops, estratégias de deployment e automação de testes.   • Liderar iniciativas de modernização, integração de sistemas legados e adoção responsável de serviços gerenciados.   • Integrar soluções de Gen AI, APIs de LLMs e automação inteligente com controles de segurança, privacidade, avaliação e observabilidade.   • Realizar troubleshooting avançado e liderar tecnicamente incidentes críticos, análise de causa raiz e post-mortems sem culpabilização.   • Conduzir ações de Fin Ops, capacity planning e otimização contínua de custos, performance e confiabilidade.      Profundidade esperada em AWS    Espera-se conhecimento aprofundado em pelo menos quatro dos domínios AWS listados acima e capacidade comprovada de avaliar, selecionar e integrar serviços adequados nos demais domínios. A posição não exige domínio prático de todos os serviços citados, mas requer visão sistêmica, entendimento de trade-offs e habilidade para aprender rapidamente novas capacidades da plataforma.      Competências comportamentais   • Comunicação oral e escrita clara, adaptada a engenheiros, executivos, clientes e profissionais comerciais.   • Capacidade de facilitar reuniões, workshops e decisões técnicas complexas.   • Liderança pelo exemplo e habilidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal.   • Capacidade e interesse genuíno em ensinar, mentorar e desenvolver outros profissionais..   • Escuta ativa, abertura a feedback e maturidade para conduzir conversas técnicas difíceis.   • Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar velocidade, qualidade, segurança, risco e custo.   • Orientação ao cliente e compreensão do impacto das decisões técnicas no negócio.   • Senso de ownership, pragmatismo, colaboração e responsabilidade pelos resultados.   • Capacidade de negociar prioridades, lidar com ambiguidades e administrar conflitos técnicos.   • Organização para atuar simultaneamente em oportunidades comerciais e projetos em execução.      Requisitos   • Experiência relevante em engenharia de software, infraestrutura ou cloud, com atuação significativa em AWS.   • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead, Arquiteto de Soluções ou principal referência técnica de uma equipe.   • Histórico de desenho, implantação e sustentação de soluções AWS em produção.   • Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com clientes ou apoiando atividades de pré-venda.   • Capacidade de produzir e apresentar diagramas utilizando ícones oficiais AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.   • Experiência com arquitetura de software, APIs, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, integração orientada a eventos e serverless.   • Experiência com Terraform, pipelines CI/CD, containers, observabilidade e práticas de Dev Sec Ops.   • Capacidade de estimar esforço, capacidade, custo e riscos técnicos de soluções.   • Conhecimento de segurança por design, governança, alta disponibilidade, disaster recovery e Fin Ops.      Diferenciais   • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional.   • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.   • Certificações AWS Certified Security - Specialty ou AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer - Professional.   • Experiência com Azure, GCP, ambientes híbridos ou estratégias multi-cloud.   • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock, agentes, RAG, avaliação de modelos e soluções corporativas de IA generativa.   • Experiência em consultoria, serviços profissionais, ambientes regulados ou atendimento a clientes enterprise.   • Inglês técnico ou avançado para documentação, apresentações e interação com clientes ou parceiros internacionais.      Serviços e conhecimentos relevantes Governança e identidade  AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, IAM Identity Center, SCPs, AWS Config, Cloud Trail, landing zones e ambientes multi-account.   Redes e entrega  VPC, Route 53, Transit Gateway, Private Link, Elastic Load Balancing, Cloud Front, API Gateway, Direct Connect e VPN.   Segurança  KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, Guard Duty, Security Hub, Inspector, Macie, least privilege e threat modeling.   Computação  EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e arquiteturas serverless.   Dados e integração  S3, RDS/Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Kinesis, MSK, Glue, Athena e Redshift.   Observabilidade e resiliência  Cloud Watch, X-Ray, Open Telemetry, AWS Backup, Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Service, Elastic Disaster Recovery, SLI/SLO e testes de recuperação.   Engenharia e automação  Terraform em ambientes complexos, módulos e pipelines Ia C; conhecimento de Cloud Formation ou CDK; CI/CD, Git, testes automatizados e Systems Manager.   Fin Ops  Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Cost and Usage Reports/Data Exports, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, tagging e alocação de custos.   IA generativa  Amazon Bedrock, Guardrails, Knowledge Bases, Agents, integração segura de modelos, avaliação, privacidade e observabilidade de aplicações de IA.      Vem fazer parte do time! Aguardamos a sua inscrição!!

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de contabilidade sênior em rio grande do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à CHANDON, uma Maison de vinhos espumantes renomada mundialmente, com uma rica herança e um espírito inovador. Como parte do prestigiado grupo Moët Hennessy (MH) e do conglomerado de luxo LVMH, a CHANDON oferece um ambiente de trabalho excepcional onde a paixão pela excelência e a busca pela inovação se encontram. Nossos colaboradores são a essência do nosso sucesso, e valorizamos um ambiente seguro, saudável e sustentável.      Responsabilidades: Garantir a aplicação adequada das exigências do BRGAAP, IFRS, CPC e do GAAP do Grupo em transações contábeis e relatórios financeiros. Executar e apoiar o processo de fechamento financeiro mensal, garantindo que todos os custos incorridos sejam devidamente registrados, os lançamentos contábeis (diários) sejam precisos, as conciliações de contas sejam concluídas no prazo e os relatórios financeiros sejam preparados conforme os prazos estabelecidos. Preparar e revisar conciliações do razão geral (General Ledger) e lançamentos contábeis, garantindo precisão, consistência e conformidade com as normas contábeis. Garantir a integridade e a manutenção adequada do razão geral e do plano de contas, incluindo a classificação e o registro corretos das transações. Preparar análises detalhadas de contas e lançamentos contábeis de suporte para transações complexas ou não rotineiras. Realizar o tratamento contábil, a validação e a conciliação de impostos, incluindo IPI, ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL, PIS, COFINS, ISS e outros tributos aplicáveis, garantindo que os créditos fiscais sejam devidamente calculados, fundamentados e reconhecidos de forma apropriada nos registros contábeis, considerando a reforma tributária e as aplicações de sistemas. Preparar o cálculo de custo médio e de estoques de acordo com os Princípios Contábeis. Apoiar as atividades de contabilidade do ativo imobilizado, incluindo revisões fiscais e de vida útil, além de avaliações de terrenos. Preparar e analisar as contas " B. Home" e as respectivas conciliações contábeis. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de sistemas, iniciativas de automação, controles e práticas de negócios para aumentar a eficiência e a confiabilidade dos dados. Preparar e implementar políticas e procedimentos contábeis concebidos para fortalecer a governança, a conformidade e a prevenção de fraudes. Apoiar os processos de auditoria interna e externa mediante a preparação de documentação, o atendimento a solicitações e a garantia de conformidade com os requisitos de auditoria e de relatórios. Apoiar a análise dos impactos fiscais sobre as transações contábeis e as demonstrações financeiras, assegurando o tratamento contábil adequado. Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios locais, estaduais e federais. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Contabilidade, Tributário e Tesouraria para assegurar o alinhamento e a coordenação das atividades contábeis e dos requisitos de relatórios anuais.    Requisitos: Experiência com auditorias externas e/ou internas. Sólidas habilidades técnicas em relatórios financeiros ( financial reporting ). Conhecimento sólido de normas contábeis e contabilidade tributária. Experiência com SAP ECC. Excelentes habilidades analíticas. Visão de negócios ( business oriented ). Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas tarefas ( multitask ). Foco em prazos e cumprimento de cronogramas. Excelente conhecimento de Excel. Disponibilidade de mudança ou residir nas cidades de Garibaldi, Bento Gonçalves, Carlos Barbosa ou Caxias do Sul. Inglês é um diferencial.

title: Logistics specialist- first mile
description:
Empresa está contratando Logistics specialist- first mile em guarulhos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT SHEIN    SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!        Key Responsibilities   ● Pickup Operations Management: Oversee daily pickup operations across Brazil, ensuring sellers are collected within SLA and operational targets. Coordinate pickup flows with logistics providers, monitor execution quality, and proactively address operational risks, delays, and capacity constraints.   ● Supplier Coordination & Performance Management: Manage relationships with pickup service providers and carriers, conducting regular operational reviews, aligning volume forecasts, and ensuring compliance with company standards and KPIs. Drive accountability and corrective actions when performance deviations occur.   ● Data Analysis & Decision Making: Analyze operational data, pickup performance, seller behavior, capacity utilization, and cost indicators to support strategic and operational decision-making. Develop reports and dashboards to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.   ● Operational Planning & Execution: Support short-, medium-, and long-term pickup planning, balancing operational efficiency, service quality, and cost optimization. Coordinate operational contingencies during peak periods and large-scale campaigns.   ● Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps and implement initiatives to improve pickup efficiency, reduce failures, enhance seller experience, and optimize operational costs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve systems, operational processes, and execution standards.   ● Incident Management & Escalation Handling: Lead operational issue resolution related to pickup execution, seller complaints, collection failures, and supplier performance. Ensure fast escalation, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.   ● Field Operations & Seller Experience: Conduct field visits with logistics providers and sellers to validate operational standards, improve pickup experience, and ensure operational compliance. Maintain close visibility of frontline operational challenges.   ● Strategic Projects & Network Development: Support strategic initiatives related to pickup network expansion, operational model optimization, collection point management, and logistics performance improvement projects.      Requirements   ● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related fields.   ● Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce, express logistics, or first mile operations.   ● Strong knowledge of pickup operations, logistics supplier management, operational KPIs, and field execution.   ● Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make operational decisions based on data, performance indicators, and operational trends.   ● Operational & Analytical Profile: Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced environment.   ● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong ability to identify root causes, manage operational risks, and implement corrective and preventive actions.   ● Supplier Management Experience: Experience coordinating logistics providers, conducting performance reviews, and driving operational improvements.   ● Project Management Skills: Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional logistics projects.   ● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to engage directly with field operations, logistics providers, and sellers to ensure operational excellence.   ● Portuguese fluency is mandatory.   ● Intermediate English is required; fluent English is considered a strong plus.   ● Spanish and/or Mandarin are considered a plus.      CAREERS AT SHEIN    We Commit to Inclusion    At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.    We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers    At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.    We Engage with Global Cultures    SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.        Location: GLP Guarulhos II - R. Concretex, 800 - Cumbica, Guarulhos - SP,

This role requires strong command of both languages, not just one. You must be eligible to work as a self-employed/freelance contractor (sole trader or via your own Personal Service Company). We're onboarding quickly for this project, so please only apply if you can start within the next few days and are able to respond promptly throughout the process. Most contributors find that meeting project output needs takes around 10 to 15 hours per week, with flexibility to take on up to a maximum of 30 hours per week depending on project need and your availability. If you're based in Brazil, fluent in both English and Portuguese, and this sounds like the flexible, remote opportunity you've been looking for, apply now to find out more.

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Data specialist (with advanced english) em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.    About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.        Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Product designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Product designer em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We believe in a world where research never sleeps.       Most companies struggle to understand their customers. Not because they don't try, but because market research can be siloed, slow, and incomplete.      Discuss is changing that.       Our mission is to elevate human understanding at scale by building the always-on solution that transforms market research, making it continuous and intelligent while keeping humans at the center. We’ve built a comprehensive, innovative, set of AI-driven solutions that have made us only one of two companies named a Leader in the Forrester Wave Q1 2026 Experience Research Platforms Report. Discuss has earned top rankings by G2 for Best Results, Customer Relationships, Usability, and more for 14 consecutive quarters. We’re not slowing down any time soon.       In the age of AI, scaling empathy without losing human understanding matters. Solving this problem makes what we do every day both interesting and rewarding. Our team believes in doing the right thing, even when it's inconvenient. We build tools that customers love because we listen to them. We believe in transparency and we own the results together.       Discuss is a team of 200+ employees in 23 countries, serving 900 customers worldwide. We hire people who care about the humans on the other side of the data and want to help build something that hasn't existed before.      If you want your work to make the distance between organizations and the people they serve feel, for once, like it isn't there, we'd love to talk.      About this role  We're rebuilding how design happens at Discuss: an AI-assisted, code-native process where prototypes are real running code, feedback happens on live URLs instead of static frames, and a shared component system keeps design and engineering from drifting apart.      We're looking for an AI Forward Product Designer who's excited to work this way, someone comfortable moving fast with AI tools while keeping a high bar for craft, structure, and accessibility.      You'll own design work end to end across the pipeline: framing the problem, wireframing the flows, generating high-fidelity prototypes as code, running feedback on live previews, and closing the loop into our component library.      How this role works You'll own solutions in your own area of the product, working closely with a product manager and engineers, and may float between teams as coverage is needed. You'll collaborate weekly with the design director and the other design ICs for team alignment and growth.    What you'll do Take features from problem to prototype. Help frame the problem and write lightweight specs, then move into wireframes and high-fidelity work. Generate high-fidelity, interactive prototypes as real code (React, shadcn, Tailwind) using AI tools like Claude Code/Design, working against our shared design tokens and components. Wireframe in low fidelity first, focusing on structure and flow before visual polish, covering every real state and not just the happy path. Run feedback on live prototypes hosted on Vercel. Gather comments, triage them, and fold decisions back into the work and the spec. Keep the design system honest. Contribute components and tokens back to our shared shadcn registry and its hosted component reference (Storybook), so what's designed matches what ships. Work in the open, in version control. Your specs, flows, wireframes, and prototypes live as files in the repo, reviewed like code. Design with light and dark mode and accessibility built in from the start, not bolted on.    What we're looking for Around 4 years of product design experience. Strong product design fundamentals: interaction design, layout, information hierarchy, and a good eye for visual craft. Strong taste and design judgment. You can tell what's working and what isn't, edit toward the better version, and raise the quality bar without needing every decision spelled out. Comfort with AI-assisted design tools and a willingness to work in a convention-driven way, where shared rules guide and review the work. Enough technical fluency to work in code-based prototypes. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable reading and adjusting React and Tailwind, and working in a repo (Git, pull requests, markdown). Experience with component-based design systems and design tokens. Solid grasp of accessibility (WCAG basics, keyboard nav, contrast, semantics). Clear communication with product and engineering. You can write a tight spec and explain a design decision.    Nice to have Experience running or designing for usability tests. Familiarity with Figma as a fine-tuning and handoff tool (we use it selectively, not as our source of truth). Experience with Storybook, or documenting a design system for other teams to build against. Exposure to MCP-based or other shared-system tooling across multiple products or teams. Experience designing for B2 B or B2 B2 C Saa S products.    How is success measured in this role Speed from wireframe approved to stakeholder sign-off. You help shrink that gap. Handoff fidelity. The work you promote into the component library holds up against production code without heavy rework. Quality of feedback. Prototypes are real and clickable enough that stakeholders react precisely, early, and often. Product outcomes. Work you ship moves adoption metrics (via Pendo) in the intended direction, and usability issues don't show up as a recurring theme in post-launch feedback or drive avoidable rework.

description:

Assistente de Produção de Conteúdo & Conferências (Conference Producer) Empresa: MARTIN Summits    Foco: Encontros estratégicos e summits B2 B para C-Levels e tomadores de decisão    Regime: A definir   --- 1. Visão Geral da Função    O Assistente de Produção de Conteúdo & Conferências é o elo estratégico entre as dores do mercado e os palcos dos nossos summits. Sua missão não é apenas operacional: você será responsável por mapear os temas mais críticos da economia, traduzir tendências em trilhas de conteúdo e convencer os líderes mais influentes do país (CEOs, VPs, Diretores) a subirem em nossos palcos.    Se você tem curiosidade intelectual para entender negócios, excelente comunicação interpessoal e ambição de criar networking de altíssimo nível, esta cadeira é a porta de entrada para a indústria de conferências executivas.   --- 2. Principais Responsabilidades   #### A. Pesquisa de Mercado & Curadoria de Pauta ( Market Research ) Conduzir desk research , leitura de relatórios setoriais e conversas exploratórias com executivos para mapear dores e prioridades de cada indústria. Identificar hot topics , tendências emergentes e casos práticos de sucesso que atraiam a atenção de decisores. Estruturar a grade do evento: desenhar títulos atrativos, resumos provocativos e definir formatos ideais (palestras magnas, painéis de debate, roundtables ). #### B. Atração e Gestão de Palestrantes ( Speaker Recruitment ) Mapear e prospectar ativamente líderes C-Level, especialistas e autoridades via Linked In, e-mail e telefone. Fazer o pitch de valor da MARTIN Summits, negociando a participação de palestrantes de renome (maioria sem cachê/participação editorial). Gerenciar toda a jornada do palestrante: briefing da sessão, alinhamento de expectativas, coleta de biografias, fotos e aprovação de apresentações. #### C. Alinhamento Multidisciplinar ( Cross-functional ) Comercial / Patrocínio: Garantir a integração ética e qualificada de patrocinadores na grade, preservando a autoridade técnica do evento. Marketing: Fornecer ganchos editoriais, destaques de palestrantes e argumentos de valor para campanhas de atração de público qualificado. Operações & Palco: Apoiar a execução no dia do evento, coordenando a sala VIP de palestrantes, tempos de fala ( timekeeping ) e transição das sessões. --- 3. Requisitos e Qualificações Formação: Graduação em andamento ou concluída em Jornalismo, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Comunicação Social, Marketing, Letras ou áreas correlatas. Comunicação Executiva: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (fluência para conversar de igual para igual com diretores e C-Levels). Idiomas: Inglês intermediário a avançado (leitura confortável de relatórios globais e facilidade para abordar executivos internacionais). Organização e Autonomia: Domínio de ferramentas de produtividade (Google Workspace/Excel, Notion/Trello/Asana). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia em feiras/eventos B2 B, prospecção ativa (SDR/comercial), redação econômica ou assessoria de imprensa. --- 4. Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills) Resiliência e Persuasão: Não se intimidar com a hierarquia corporativa e ter habilidade para contornar objeções de agenda de executivos. Curiosidade Intelectual: Interesse genuíno por negócios, finanças, tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade. Atenção aos Detalhes: Capacidade de acompanhar prazos rígidos, grafia correta de cargos/nomes e padrões de qualidade visual. --- 5. Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs)   | KPI | Objetivo |   | :--- | :--- |   | Pipeline de Palestrantes | Cumprimento do cronograma de confirmações de C-Levels por etapa do evento. |   | Relevância e Diversidade da Grade | Equilíbrio de empresas de grande porte representadas e diversidade nos painéis. |   | SLA de Materiais | Coleta de 100% de bios, fotos e apresentações dentro dos prazos pré-evento. |   | NPS do Conteúdo | Nota de satisfação dos participantes em relação à qualidade técnica da conferência. |   ---

title: Online teacher - whole child education | iws online school
description:
Nova oportunidade para Online teacher - whole child education | iws online school em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.      At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects , and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.    We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.    You may have many years of teaching experience.    You may have relatively little.    That is not the first thing we look at.      We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.    What is much harder to train is:   Genuine care for children Empathy and emotional awareness Positive energy and warmth Strong character and responsibility Curiosity and willingness to learn A real desire to make a difference in a child’s life    The role    You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.    This includes:   Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons Teaching your specialist subject effectively Building strong relationships with students Understanding each child as an individual Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families Participating in training and continuous professional development    Who we are looking for    We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.    What matters most is not simply what you teach.    It is how you make children feel while they are learning.    We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.    There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.    We take that responsibility seriously.    Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.    If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.    When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.    Not your best lesson.    The child.

title: Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled
description:
Empresa está contratando Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Emperor Rentals is a U. S. vacation-rental and real-estate business seeking a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager based in Brazil for a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time. You will work with our Portuguese-speaking team and communicate clearly in English with U. S. management and our external accountant.      This is a very hands-on individual-contributor role. You will personally perform day-to-day bookkeeping and financial housekeeping: clean up transactions, organize receipts, reconcile accounts, prepare owner statements, and produce recurring reports. You will own follow-through from source documents to accurate books and completed reporting. You will also improve these financial workflows using AI.      COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE    USD $250 per week. Required schedule: FULL-TIME, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time (New York time, following Eastern daylight-saving changes). You must be available for this fixed schedule; general time-zone overlap is not sufficient. Confirm your availability and acceptance of this weekly budget in your proposal. Long-term collaboration is intended, subject to performance and mutual agreement.      WHAT YOU WILL OWN   - Daily Quick Books Online bookkeeping across separate legal entities: bank/card feeds, accurate categories, property classes, receipts, and an aged exception list.   - Bank and credit-card reconciliations to actual statements, with every difference explained and supporting documents retained.   - Owner Rez accounting: reconcile property expenses and owner statements to Quick Books, distinguish reimbursements from service income, and prepare weekly property-management transfer schedules for approval.   - Keep guest/owner trust funds, operating cash, intercompany transfers, owner distributions, and business income correctly separated.   - Reconcile Airbnb, Vrbo, , Stripe and other payouts, fees, commissions, refunds and chargebacks to bookings and bank deposits.   - Prepare monthly owner statements and property-level reports, apply review corrections promptly, and track completion through final approval.   - Support weekly payroll and contractor-payment reconciliation across time/work records, payment-provider records and the bank, including fees and failed or duplicate payments.   - Retrieve mortgage and utility support, prepare principal/interest/escrow allocations, and maintain property-specific records.   - Deliver monthly P& L, balance-sheet support, reconciliation schedules and a clear list of unresolved items. Support W-9/1099 preparation under the external accountant's approved instructions.      AI-ASSISTED ACCOUNTING   - Use approved AI tools to help extract invoice data, propose transaction classifications, compare exports, investigate differences, draft reports and document procedures.   - Build repeatable spreadsheet and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.   - Verify every AI-generated calculation, classification and proposed entry against source documents. Keep a clear audit trail and follow company data-access policies.   - Retain personal responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the books, and obtain required approval before posting adjustments or releasing payments.      REQUIRED EXPERIENCE   - At least 3 years of hands-on U. S. bookkeeping/accounting and Quick Books Online, with ownership of reconciliations, monthly close and financial reporting.   - Either practical experience using AI tools in finance/accounting, OR a strong willingness to learn and consistently use AI in our financial workflows. Prior AI expertise is not required; careful verification, curiosity and adoption of our tools are required.   - Strong bank reconciliation, double-entry accounting, balance-sheet cleanup and multi-entity experience.   - Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling large exports.   - Professional Portuguese and strong written/spoken English. Based in Brazil for team collaboration and working-hour alignment.   - Ability to spot duplicates, missing receipts, incorrect periods, wrong properties and unsupported classifications without waiting for the owner to find them.   - Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and willingness to use Hubstaff for agreed work-time reporting.      STRONGLY PREFERRED    Property management, vacation rentals, real estate or trust/owner accounting; Owner Rez; OTA/Stripe payout reconciliation; Quick Books Pro Advisor certification; familiarity with Slack, Notion, Operto or similar operations tools. An accounting degree is welcome.      HOW WE DEFINE GOOD WORK    Accurate reconciliations, clear evidence and dependable completion dates. Review new bank-feed items each business day and process supported items within one business day where possible. Escalate missing information with an owner and due date. Reconcile before declaring work complete. Flag unclear instructions, explain accounting implications, document decisions and improve repetitive workflows. Payment release and tax decisions remain subject to management/accountant approval.      TO APPLY   1. Describe your U. S. Quick Books and property-management experience, including the number of entities/accounts you managed.   2. Explain how you would handle a property repair paid by Operations and later reimbursed from owner funds without double-counting income.   3. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered, how you proved it and how you prevented recurrence.   4. Explain your monthly-close checklist and how you track missing receipts and unresolved differences.   5. Describe how you currently use AI, or confirm your willingness to learn and use AI in our financial workflows. Explain how you would check its output for accuracy.   6. Confirm your location in Brazil, English/Portuguese proficiency, availability for the full-time Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern schedule, and acceptance of USD $250 per week.      Please share only anonymized examples with no client financial details. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a separately agreed paid practical exercise using sample data. We value sound judgment, careful work and clear communication.

The successful candidate will work closely with design teams to define verification strategies, improve verificationefficiency through automation, and ensure high-quality verification processes.      Key Responsibilities  Verification Lifecycle Ownership Own and execute the complete verification lifecycle from system-level concept through tape-out and post-silicon support. Develop and execute verification strategies for digital power IPs. Define verification environments, tools, and testing methodologies.  Testbench Methodology Development Develop pre-silicon test plans for digital power IPs. Build and maintain verification testbenches using System Verilog UVM methodology. Develop functional coverage models and assertion-based verification. Perform formal verification activities including property checking. title: Program manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Program manager em taubaté. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility?    Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere.    Main missions:   Manages and delivers the project (OP and Customer) objectives and deliverables. Responsible for the project profitability Manages the complete development budget and cash flow for the entire project. Delivers a non-event launch of the project into production Represents OP at the customer and represents the customer in OP Promote EHS and quality requirements internally and externally Project Definition Ensures the OPTIMAP Project plan and total development budget is in accordance with the agreed Customer Statement of Work and validated project scope. Leads the core team member's OPTIMAP work packages and their agreed development budgets, in agreement with the project objectives and the project scope Establishes and manages the master project timing plan and consolidates negotiated planning of each core team member ensuring it conforms to the customer and OPTIMAP timing plans Responsible for the profitability of the project and sets the core team members' targets to work towards in line with the project objectives. (Development hours, PRU, investments, cash flow, Costs of Non-Quality). Follows and applies the direction of the division cascaded by the Program director. At the end of the project assesses the status against the original project objectives and feeds back lessons learned. Actions management / Reporting / Risks In line with the OPTIMAP Project Plan, consolidates the global project status and ensures that the core teams are accountable for their status for the deliverables completion in the division Information Systems. Manages and identifies deviations from the planned Project Plan and validates the actions proposed by the core team members to realign. Responsible for organizing project meetings, project reviews and end of phase reviews with all core team members to review project status and project action plan follow-up. Prepares and presents the gateway reports to the OPTIMAP committee and, in anticipation of the gate event, issues the gate validation report. Consolidates the threats and opportunities of each department, prioritizes and manages the action plan to respond to the risks throughout the project phases. Responsible for the financial control / reporting of the project budget using the standard BG tools to consolidate and reporting cash flow and profitability to program reviews. Split of the project development budget by department and delegation to the core team members for their financial control / reporting (excluding payment/expenditure authorization). Manages the scope change (internal / external) process and ensures the project budget is updated (hours, investment and production costs). Manages project development expenditure versus the planned budget, identifies any deviation (hours, investments and production costs), and takes appropriate actions to realign. Manages the project cash flow, including tooling and other costs. Only project team members can authorize payment to suppliers respecting OPs procedures and terms. Responsible for ensuring the contribution and actions of all project team members to achieve a non-event launch. Challenges that the optimum technical and manufacturing solutions / choices are made by the project team to meet the design to cost project objectives. Provides periodic reporting to the program director, plant director, department managers and sales director highlighting the key project progress and risks through the program review process. Follows the project reporting of each core team member to manage the escalation process of issues and risks and the achievement of their project actions. Team / people Ensures the coordination of the project team, communication management, project meeting organization, conflict resolution and building an effective team. Ensures the project team applies the methodology of development - OPTIMAP through adequate division Information Systems In line with the project development budget identifies the resource needs, skills and locations to meet the project objectives. Contributes to the annual assessment process of the core team members. Responsible to ensure the project team apply company standards and best practices as defined by each department to maximise the productivity of the development budget. Ensures the health and safety of the project team and the respect of the environment Applies and respects the procedures of the engineering and plant sites and the responsibility for control or destruction of project parts and waste. Customer Is OP's accountable representative of the project for the customer With the support of the PQL ensures the actions of the customer APQP process and final customer validation files (PPAP, PSW...) are cascaded and managed through the project team. Responsible for the coordination / management of all the project team members' communications to the customer and ensure the core team members take their responsibility in front of the customer. Is responsible for ensuring that all the customer deliverables (customer approval, APQP, build deliveries etc.) are managed and delivered by the project team and reports the progress to the customer in line with the agreed Statement Of Work. Identifies to the Commercial Project Manager and the customer, customer scope changes to the agreed Customer Statement of Work in accordance to the budget of development (hours, travel costs, costs / hour) and the OPTIMAP project plan. Supports the Commercial Project Manager in the negotiation of customer scope changes. Department Participates in the establishment and the delivery of the department progress plans Participates in the continuous improvement of the departments, organization and methodologies, with actions of lessons learned, best practices and productivity. Cascading / be a mentor for another junior program manager.  At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward.    Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You'll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow's automotive industry.    Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions.    With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R& D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

Em quase duas décadas de atuação, tornou-se referência nacional em silvicultura de madeira nobre, com milhares de hectares sob gestão e centenas de clientes. Estamos construindo uma cultura AI-first em nossos departamentos e buscamos pessoas que queiram aprender, assumir responsabilidades, melhorar processos e crescer junto com a empresa. Sobre a Vaga Buscamos um(a) Analista de Operações Comerciais para apoiar e organizar a operação dos SDRs e consultores de negócios, garantindo que processos, informações, materiais e atividades comerciais sigam os fluxos definidos pela diretoria. Essa pessoa será responsável pela operação e governança do CRM, pelo acompanhamento dos indicadores da jornada comercial e pelo suporte de bastidor à equipe. Também participará da criação e melhoria de scripts, propostas, relatórios, automações, treinamentos e procedimentos. A posição é ligada diretamente à diretoria e terá espaço para identificar problemas, analisar gargalos e propor melhorias nos processos comerciais e na jornada do cliente. Não se trata de uma função de atendimento ou negociação direta com leads e clientes. O foco estará na organização, análise e melhoria da operação, apoiando três consultores de negócios e dois SDRs. Responsabilidades • Administrar e manter organizado todo o fluxo comercial no CRM; • Distribuir leads entre SDRs e consultores de negócios conforme os critérios definidos pela diretoria; • Conferir o preenchimento das informações e garantir a qualidade dos dados registrados no CRM; • Acompanhar a movimentação dos leads e oportunidades entre as etapas do funil; • Identificar leads parados, atividades vencidas, oportunidades sem acompanhamento e falhas no processo; • Cobrar e acompanhar a atualização das informações pelos responsáveis; • Monitorar o cumprimento dos procedimentos, prazos e rotinas comerciais; • Acompanhar os indicadores de toda a jornada comercial, desde a entrada do lead pelo marketing até o fechamento ou perda da oportunidade; • Elaborar relatórios e painéis para acompanhamento da diretoria; • Monitorar volume de leads, tentativas de contato, chamadas, reuniões agendadas e realizadas, propostas enviadas, conversões por etapa, motivos de perda e produtividade da equipe; • Apoiar a elaboração da previsão de vendas e o acompanhamento do pipeline comercial; • Organizar e conferir as informações utilizadas no cálculo das comissões; • Criar, revisar e manter atualizados scripts de prospecção, atendimento, qualificação e acompanhamento; • Criar, preencher, adaptar e melhorar modelos de propostas comerciais; • Redigir novos materiais e versões de scripts e propostas para validação da diretoria; • Construir e aprimorar materiais comerciais em conjunto com SDRs, consultores de negócios, diretoria e corpo consultivo; • Apoiar a organização de campanhas comerciais, listas de prospecção e distribuição de oportunidades; • Auditar ligações, mensagens e registros comerciais para verificar a aderência aos procedimentos estabelecidos; • Identificar gargalos, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria no funil, nos scripts, nos procedimentos e nos fluxos da jornada do cliente; • Propor melhorias à diretoria com base em dados, evidências e observações da operação; • Documentar processos, procedimentos, padrões e orientações do departamento comercial; • Apoiar o treinamento e a integração de novos SDRs e consultores de negócios; • Organizar contratos, propostas, documentos e informações dos clientes durante o processo comercial; Somos uma plataforma de anúncios online que nasceu com um propósito claro: descomplicar a vida de quem quer comprar ou vender imóveis e veículos. Hoje, contamos com +16 milhões de acessos mensais na nossa plataforma, +15 mil clientes, e +4.8 milhões de anúncios publicados.      Nosso time é movido por desafios, inovação e aquele brilho nos olhos de quem sabe que tá fazendo história. Já pensou fazer parte de algo gigante assim?      Aqui, sua carreira pode crescer tanto quanto a gente. Bora?      Conheça o nosso manifesto:    O mundo é movido por pessoas que fazem acontecer.    Fazer acontecer é uma maneira de viver.    Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.    Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças.    Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação.    É nisso que acreditamos. Essa é a nossa essência.    Chegamos até aqui porque cremos em nossos resultados e no nosso propósito de descomplicar a vida das pessoas.    Com uma liderança forte, visão audaciosa, cultura inspiradora e uma equipe composta de pessoas incríveis, formamos uma empresa pungente que pensa no coletivo.    Afinal, se um ganha, todos ganham.    Nossa ambição é grandiosa.    E possível.    Prazer. Somos o Chaves na Mão.      Quais são os nossos valores?   - Fazemos do nosso jeito: Somos ousados e não tememos trilhar nosso caminho da nossa maneira.   - O bife vira: Não desistimos no primeiro obstáculo e cremos sempre que vamos virar o jogo.   - Olho no resultado: Nossas ações sempre focam um resultado final e positivo.   - Curtimos a jornada: Curtimos a escalada rumo ao topo entendendo que pessoas felizes performam melhor.   - Time vencedor joga junto: Sabemos que todo campeonato só é vencido por um time unido pela mesma visão. description:

Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox's Burton's Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.    A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.    Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach's®, Jelly Belly®, Swee TARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry's.    Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.    Sobre a vaga    O Supervisor(a) de Recrutamento e Seleção será responsável por liderar a execução dos processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para posições operacionais, técnicas e de liderança nas unidades fabris da empresa, garantindo agilidade, qualidade das contratações e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Atuará na gestão da equipe de recrutamento, relacionamento com gestores e implementação de iniciativas que contribuam para a atração e retenção dos melhores talentos para as operações industriais.    Localidade: Marília - SP    Reporta a: Gerente de Talent e Performance    Modelo de trabalho: Presencial    Contamos com você para:   Assegurar a execução eficiente dos processos seletivos para posições operacionais, técnicas e de supervisão. Implementar estratégias de atração de talentos para atender demandas de fábrica, logística, manutenção e áreas de apoio industrial. Garantir o cumprimento dos indicadores de recrutamento, incluindo SLA das vagas, tempo de fechamento, qualidade da contratação e satisfação dos gestores. Atuar como parceiro dos líderes de operações, entendendo necessidades de mão de obra e propondo soluções de recrutamento aderentes ao planejamento do negócio. Gerenciar processos de recrutamento em volume, campanhas de contratação e projetos especiais de expansão ou ramp-up produtivo. Estabelecer parcerias com consultorias, escolas técnicas, instituições de ensino, programas de aprendizagem e demais fontes de atração de talentos. Monitorar tendências do mercado de trabalho e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de seleção. Garantir uma experiência positiva aos candidatos durante toda a jornada de recrutamento. Conduzir entrevistas por competências para posições estratégicas e de liderança operacional. Elaborar análises e relatórios gerenciais com indicadores, identificando oportunidades e riscos relacionados à aquisição de talentos. Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas, legislação trabalhista e diretrizes de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Apoiar iniciativas de employer branding voltadas ao público industrial.  Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:   Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas; Vivência com recrutamento de alto volume para posições operacionais e industriais. Experiência na liderança de equipes de recrutamento. Atuação prévia em ambientes industriais, manufatura, logística ou centros de distribuição.  O que nós oferecemos:    Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:   Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Dr Dori (telemedicina) Seguro de vida Totalpass e/ou Wellhub Vale alimentação Vale refeição Vale Natal Vale transporte Descontos em produtos  Igualdade de Oportunidades    Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.    A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC  ).    Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Regional manager, tender management and pricing
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional manager, tender management and pricing em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‐conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‐functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‐tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‐term profitability.   Responsibilities   Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions. Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‐functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs. Lead and motivate cross‐functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‐quality tender submissions. Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities. Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies. Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.). Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions. Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers. Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness. Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes. Conduct post‐tender and post‐award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices. Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions. Provide training, coaching, and best‐practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes. Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams. All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs. Qualifications   Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required. Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required. Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced). 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding. Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks. Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely. Strong analytical and problem‐solving capabilities. Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information. Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.). Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‐site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.   Work Location:   Paulista Area, São Paulo Work Model:   100% On-site   Job Responsibilities   Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary. Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients. Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements. Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company. Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders. Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes. Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF. Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices. Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred. Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations. Viagens Cobertas: Reembolso de 100% para todas as despesas de viagem relacionadas ao trabalho. Exposição Global: Oportunidades únicas para colaboração internacional e viagens para a sede nos EUA.   Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades   Estamos comprometidos com a diversidade e inclusão em nosso local de trabalho e incentivamos candidaturas de todas as pessoas, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.   Field Application Engineer – Smart Agricultural Technology   Location: Brazil (Field-based with opportunities for US travel)   Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent   About Our Client   Our client is a fast-growing pioneer in the agricultural robotics space, revolutionizing the farming industry by designing and building advanced, autonomous farm machines. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, their technology enables farmers to understand and manage fields at a plant-by-plant level.   Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.   We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.   This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.   Key Responsibilities   As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:   In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation. Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs. Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials. Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution. Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required. What We Are Looking For   Minimum Requirements:   Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal). Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 2+ years of experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery). Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components. Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude. Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields. Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):   Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming. Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT). Basic programming/scripting skills in Python. Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., Solid Works ). Physical Requirements & Working Conditions   This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold). Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds). Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems. What's on Offer   Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture. Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer. Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses. Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.

Proficiency in SQL and Excel/spreadsheets is required; experience with BI tools is a plus. Ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured frameworks and actionable plans. Strong business judgment focused on ROI, trade-offs, and pragmatic prioritization. Clear communication skills with experience aligning commercial, BD, and executive stakeholders. Governança, riscos e controles internos   Implementar e monitorar controles internos relacionados à gestão financeira de contratos, assegurando segregação de funções, rastreabilidade e aderência ao princípio dos quatro olhos. Manter procedimentos operacionais documentados, com versões e auditáveis para as atividades sob responsabilidade do GFC. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, disponibilizando informações, evidências e documentações relacionadas aos processos sob sua responsabilidade. Atuar como ponto focal para melhorias de processo, automações sistêmicas e fortalecimento dos controles operacionais. Acompanhar vencimentos, rolagens, baixas e liquidações relacionadas aos contratos, garantindo comunicação tempestiva com as áreas envolvidas. Contribuir para a governança financeira do ciclo de vida dos contratos de algodão, desde a originação até o fechamento financeiro. Gestão de pessoas   Coordenar e desenvolver a equipe de Gestão Financeira de Contratos, assegurando capacitação contínua e alinhamento aos procedimentos corporativos. Definir prioridades operacionais da equipe, acompanhando desempenho, produtividade, cumprimento de SLAs e qualidade das entregas. A COFCO International é uma empresa que promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os talentos qualificados são bem-vindos e considerados para nossas vagas, sem distinção de raça ou etnia, crença religiosa, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade, pessoa com deficiência (Pc D) e outras características protegidas por lei. Habilidades: forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamento com distribuidores; visão analítica para gestão de estoque e KPIs de canal (DOI, OTIF, fill rate); orientação a resultados; comunicação clara com múltiplos stakeholders; disponibilidade para viagens; inglês desejável.

Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. Se você tem boa capacidade de organização e análise, facilidade para se comunicar e colaborar, e consegue unir a sua visão estratégica com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar entregando experiências extraordinárias, e nós vamos te ajudar a voar muito mais alto. Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).   Quem é você:   Você tem:   - Superior Completo e/ou Pós-Graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia ou áreas Tecnológicas voltadas à indústria ou afins;   - Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes (mínimo de 30 pessoas);   - Experiência com rotinas e processos de linha de produção e/ou montagem de produtos;   - Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua com base na aplicação das técnicas e princípios do Lean Manufacturing;   - Conhecimento nas ferramentas da indústria 4.0;   - Desejável experiência e conhecimento em legislações aplicáveis em gestão de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em empresas de grande porte;   - Pacote Office intermediário;   - Desejável Inglês intermediário.   Onde você vai estar:   Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.   Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:   - Descontos nos produtos e serviços da Electrolux;   - Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;   - Participação nos lucros anuais;   - Licença parental estendida (6 meses de licença maternidade, 4 semanas de licença paternidade);   - Acesso ao Gympass;   - Amplas oportunidades de aprendizado e flexibilidade de carreira. description:
